create_QAgent: create a QAgent instance with a model and number of actions for epsilon-greedy action selection
call_QAgent: call the QAgent to select actions using epsilon-greedy policy based on observation frames
update_QAgent: update the QAgent model weights by loading a new state dictionary
create_DQMLP: create a DQMLP neural network with dueling architecture for value and advantage estimation
forward_DQMLP: run a forward pass through the DQMLP network to compute Q-values from state inputs
